observer_and_input_source:
local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu']
local space=cpu.spaces['program']
local function field(port,name) for _,f in pairs(manager.machine.ioport.ports[port].fields) do if f.name==name then return f end end error('missing input') end
local mode=field(':PANEL1','Mode') local down=field(':PANEL3','Panel Down') local inc=field(':PANEL0','S2') local exit=field(':PANEL1','Exit')
mode:set_value(1)
local frames,stage,cooldown=0,0,0 local held=nil
tv_write=space:install_write_tap(0xf002,0xf003,'tv-system',function(a,d,m)
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value if pc==0x41ba then print(string.format('[TVWRITE] pc=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',pc,d,m)) end
end)
config_read=space:install_read_tap(0x4cb4,0x4cb5,'saved-tv',function(a,d,m)
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value if pc==0x5367 or pc==0x538c then print(string.format('[TVCONFIG] pc=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',pc,d,m)) end
end)
local function pulse(f,name) f:set_value(1) held=f cooldown=30 print('[INPUT] '..name) end
emu.register_frame_done(function()
frames=frames+1 if held then held:set_value(0) held=nil end if cooldown>0 then cooldown=cooldown-1 end
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value
if stage==0 then mode:set_value(1) if frames>90 and pc>=0x5b12 and pc<=0x5bda then mode:set_value(0) stage=1 cooldown=30 print('[ENTERED] extended setup') end
elseif stage==1 and cooldown==0 then if space:read_u8(0x4d30)<4 then pulse(down,'Panel Down') else stage=2 cooldown=30 end
elseif stage==2 and cooldown==0 then if space:read_u8(0x4cb5)==0 then pulse(inc,'S2') else stage=3 cooldown=30 end
elseif stage==3 and cooldown==0 then pulse(exit,'Exit') stage=4 end
if frames%60==0 then print(string.format('[STATE] frame=%d pc=%04x stage=%d display=%02x setup=%02x field=%02x tv=%02x',frames,pc,stage,space:read_u8(0x4d2f),space:read_u8(0x4d34),space:read_u8(0x4d30),space:read_u8(0x4cb5))) end
end)
